- **The loss is real.** Hansen data show 0.7 ha of tree-cover loss in 2023 (1.2% of the asset). That is above the 0.5 ha event minimum. The JRC 2020 map shows 100% of the area as forest, and later years (to 2025) were observed, so the corroboration rule is met.
